name: The Coop Nashville Kitchen
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Out on the Town - Long Island event calendar. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Address corrected: our record says 346 Main Street, but the venue's own site, its gift card links and Google Maps all say 342 Main Street. Phone comes from Google Maps (the site shows none). The two interior photos have a white photo-frame border built into the image, so crop to the center. No public email (catering via a form). Line dancing appears on the schedule (e.g. with 'The Salty Cowboy') but we could not tell how often; please confirm.
hours: Bar: Tue-Wed 3-11 PM; Thu 3 PM-12 AM; Fri-Sat 12 PM-2 AM; Sun 12-9 PM; closed Mon (kitchen closes earlier)
description: A Nashville-themed bar, lounge and Southern kitchen on Main Street in Farmingdale village, serving fried chicken and barbecue. It has live bands and DJs on weekends, karaoke or dueling pianos on Thursdays, and some line dancing nights.
